text:
elaine: Heads up — I'm in SF for a half day. Looking for something fast near SoMa/Embarcadero, preferably vegetarian-friendly. Any hidden gems?
raj: If you want quick + solid, try Little Lotus on 3rd. Veg curry bowls, massive. 10–15 min walk.
jordan: +1 Little Lotus. also there's a pop-up truck outside the design building today — 'Mado Sushi Truck' (sashimi bowls) if you're okay with seafood.
amy: If it's cold, tiny ramen spot on Howard (Ramen Shinju) is cozy but slow. Good if you've got time.
sam: There's also the weekend taco pop-up by 2nd & Brannan — unbelievable al pastor. Not veg though.
elaine: Thanks! Any quick coffee + pastry nearby that isn't the airport-level chaos?
raj: Blue Bottle on Embarcadero is reliable. For pastries, check 'Biscuit Bloom' on Folsom, small but great almond croissants.
jordan: FYI the food truck outside the design building accepts card only, cashless. They update IG stories if they move — @madosushitruck.
amy: @elaine if you want ultra-fast veg: the salad bar at Market & 4th (GreenCart) lets you build a bowl in 3 mins.
elaine: Sounds perfect. I'll try Little Lotus if the line is short, otherwise GreenCart. Thanks all :thumbsup:
lunchbot: Quick poll — which should we make a recurring office rec for visitors?
lunchbot: 1) Little Lotus bowls
lunchbot: 2) Ramen Shinju (ramen)
lunchbot: 3) Mado Sushi Truck (pop-up)
lunchbot: 4) GreenCart salad bar
raj: 1
jordan: 4
amy: 2
sam: 3
elaine: 1
raj: Also — pro tip: if you need to eat at desk, Little Lotus will pack in a to-go bento that fits in lap.
jordan: And Ramen Shinju has a small takeout window if you call ahead (less waiting).
elaine: Appreciate the recs — will report back on which I actually make it to :grin:
